summary: Frontend mobile smoke test reached the dashboard and empty state, opened the add-transaction modal, but the core save flow is blocked at the required mobile viewport.

ui_bugs.issue: At 375x667 the modal sheet extends below the viewport; the 'Simpan transaksi' button is outside the viewport and cannot be tapped. The modal has no internal ScrollView.

integration_issues.issue: Could not complete validation or persistence flow on mobile because save is clipped below the modal viewport.

action_items: Wrap the modal sheet content in a keyboard-aware internal ScrollView (or reduce sheet content/spacing) so the save button is reachable at 375x667 and with the keyboard open.
Add testID attributes to interactive controls for reliable mobile regression testing.
critical_code_review_comments: AddTransactionModal is a long fixed View rather than a scrollable form; this causes a functional mobile viewport failure.
Interactive Pressables generally lack testID attributes, reducing regression testability.
seed_data_creation: Cleared browser local/session storage; no seed data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard loaded and fresh empty state rendered. At 375x667, opening Catat transaksi works, but save is clipped below viewport; desktop/previous run reportedly saved successfully.
rca_of_issue: The modal sheet contains all form controls in one non-scrollable View. Its height exceeds the viewport, so the save element is outside the viewport. Root cause is missing internal ScrollView/keyboard-aware scrolling in AddTransactionModal.
test_credentials: Not applicable; local-only app with no authentication.
